decisions.what: Implementation runs on branch `pipeline` in the main checkout, not a linked worktree.
decisions.why: The build depends on live per-checkout state a worktree cannot share: x-agent/mcp/node_modules + dist, tools/node_modules, and tools/.runtime Playground descriptors. Tree was clean at branch time; isolation is by branch.

decisions.what: pipeline/ is plain ESM .mjs importing x-agent/mcp/dist directly (no TypeScript, no build step, no new npm deps); unit tests run on node:test; JSON-Schema checks use a minimal in-repo draft-07 subset validator.
decisions.why: The spec's environment says the pipeline imports dist; proof/ set the deps-free precedent; the house rule is no ajv (x-agent/tests/schemas.test.ts) and zod is not resolvable from repo root without a new node_modules.

decisions.what: S3's dry-run drift gate fails only on diff kind=value_differs in spacing.spacingSizes/layout groups; missing_on_instance entries there are ignored.
decisions.why: wp_get_global_settings serves origin-keyed spacingSizes ({default,theme}) which the emitter's differ (array-indexed) reports wholesale as missing_on_instance even for a byte-perfect pass-through; value_differs is the only kind that means an instance value would actually change. The byte-equality of the pass-through itself is asserted locally in tokenChecks.

decisions.what: Acceptance playgrounds boot programmatically on a dedicated 'pipeline-accept' slot (accept/_playground.mjs holder) at port 9410.
decisions.why: The boot CLI has no --slot flag and the default core-only-toolchain slot was held by the owner's persistent live instance on 9400, which must never be stopped or reused.

decisions.what: S5/S6 with zero declared blocks/packages are real no-ops (they initialize their artifact maps and return); W_STYLE_UNKNOWN fails a tree artifact like W_ATTR_UNKNOWN.
decisions.why: B=0/P=0 briefs must flow through the fixed stage list without factory work — the empty fan-out IS the correct behavior, not a placeholder. An is-style-* unregistered at the current fingerprint is an invented style; the spec's mechanical screen names only W_ATTR_UNKNOWN and W_STATIC_NEEDS_HARNESS, so the conservative reading fails the unknown style and the repair lane owns it.
